alan_finance: Heads up — Nimbus Dataworks sent invoice INV-5540 but it has no PO number. They referenced contract CN-88 instead. AP couldn't match -> went to exceptions.
tanya_procure: Do we have a standing PO for Nimbus? I thought we moved them to blanket PO for Q3.
lee_ap: AP log: tried match by PO id -> none. Tried vendor+amount fuzzy match -> potential match to PO-BLANKET-2023 but vendor did not include PO number so automatch failed. Invoice placed in exceptions. Link: https://ap.redwood.com/exceptions/INV-5540
ap_bot: Automated: Invoice INV-5540 flagged: missing PO number. Status: EXCEPTION. Required action: attach PO or approve manual pay.
alan_finance: Invoice snippet: ```
Vendor: Nimbus Dataworks
Invoice: INV-5540
Amount: $72,300.00
Contract ref: CN-88
Line: Model hosting monthly credits
PO: (blank)
Cost center: CC-91
```
vendor_bot: Nimbus portal message: "We accidentally omitted the PO on INV-5540. Reissue available upon request. Apologies for delay."
tanya_procure: We can't create retroactive PO for a commit without GC/contract sign-off. CN-88 is valid contract but does it authorize this spend line? Procurement needs confirmation from requestor.
alan_finance: Requestor is @cfo_jay asked to review strategic credits spend — Jay, can you confirm this aligns with CN-88? We need OK to either: 1) request vendor reissue with PO; or 2) manual approve and code to holding GL until we have docs.
cfo_jay: Confirmed: this is pre-approved under CN-88 for platform credits. We prefer vendor reissue with the PO on it for audit, but do not want payment to be delayed >30 days. Recommend manual payment with memo and then collect reissued invoice.
lee_ap: If we manual-pay, AP requires a supporting memo and procurement sign-off. I can create a temporary payment hold code "HOLD-PO-MISSING" and route to @tanya_procure for sign-off.
ap_bot: Automated: Temporary payment code HOLD-PO-MISSING applied. Invoice INV-5540 status: Pending Manual Approval (tanya_procure).
tanya_procure: I'll review and sign off if Finance attaches CN-88 excerpt and a note from Jay. Alan, please upload contract excerpt and Jay's confirmation.
alan_finance: Uploaded contract excerpt and pasted Jay's approval in the AP ticket: https://ap.redwood.com/exceptions/INV-5540#notes. Created ticket FIN-3501 to follow up with Nimbus for reissue.
lee_ap: Approved for payment by procurement. Routed to payments. AP will process under HOLD-PO-MISSING and track to ensure vendor reissues.
ap_bot: Automated: Payment scheduled (net-15) under special handling. Reminder to follow up: reissued invoice required within 30 days or we will do a debit memo.
alan_finance: Noted. I'll flag vendor master to require PO on all future invoices and add a note to vendor onboarding checklist. Closing thread once reissue received. :memo:
